etsy.title: Quiet Zone Sign, Soft Voices Library Poster, Headphones Welcome Study Area Decor, Low Stimulation Wall Art
etsy.description:
A calm Quiet Zone sign for low-stimulation spaces where soft voices and headphones are welcome.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang near a library corner, classroom quiet area, office nook, or sensory-friendly home space.

This listing is a physical poster print, not a substitute for professional medical, therapy, or educational advice. Thank you for supporting a small, neurodivergent-run shop!

competitorNotes: Etsy quiet zone signs are mostly printables with finger-to-lips graphics and 'speak quietly' text for study areas, hallways and therapy offices.
Some add a pointed tone ('mental health under construction'); a soft, low-stimulation design is a differentiator.
Most shared-project results (sensory room, calm corner, neurodiversity decor) are digital printables; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Amazon quiet zone signs are small acrylic, plastic or aluminum plaques (7x10, 8x12, 9x3) for libraries, nurseries and offices.

research.notes: Listing pages were not reachable from this environment (WebFetch blocked); evidence is from search results only. No priceRange: snippets mixed digital downloads with physical signs and did not separate physical poster prices.
